import json, subprocess, sys, random, string
random.seed(99)
MAIN='/app/submission/main.py'
CH = list(string.printable) + ['\r','\x00','\xff','\t']
base = [b'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0', b'From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=t', b'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>',
        b'Call-ID: c1', b'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', b'Content-Length: 0', b'P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>',
        b'P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>', b'Privacy: id', b'X-Odd: a b']
bad=0
for trial in range(400):
    lines = list(base)
    for _ in range(random.randint(0,4)):
        op = random.random()
        if op < 0.3 and lines:
            i = random.randrange(len(lines)); lines[i] = lines[i][:random.randrange(len(lines[i])+1)]
        elif op < 0.5:
            i = random.randrange(len(lines)); lines[i] = lines[i] + bytes([random.choice(CH)], 'latin-1')
        elif op < 0.7:
            i = random.randrange(len(lines)); c = random.choice(CH); lines[i] = lines[i] + c.encode('latin-1') + lines[i]
        elif op < 0.85 and lines:
            lines.pop(random.randrange(len(lines)))
        else:
            lines.insert(random.randrange(len(lines)+1), bytes([random.choice(CH)],'latin-1'))
    req = b'\r\n'.join(lines) + b'\r\n\r\n'
    if random.random() < 0.3:
        req = req[:random.randrange(len(req)+1)]
    doc = {"version":1,"config":{"accounts":[{"id":"alice","default":"sip:alice@lab.test","aliases":["sip:alice@lab.test","tel:+12025550100"]}],
          "peers":[{"id":"edge","mode":"access","accounts":[]},{"id":"rel","mode":"relay","accounts":["alice"]}],
          "ttl_ms":100,"capacity":5},
          "events":[{"t":0,"peer":random.choice(["edge","rel"]),"auth":random.choice([None,"alice"]),"egress":"external","wire_hex":req.hex()}]}
    if doc['events'][0]['peer']=='rel': doc['events'][0]['auth']=None
    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',MAIN], input=raw, capture_output=True, timeout=45)
    if p.returncode not in (0,2):
        bad+=1; print('BAD rc', p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:1000]); open('/workspace/tmp/crash2.json','wb').write(raw); break
    if p.returncode==0:
        o = json.loads(p.stdout)
        r = o['results'][0]
        assert r.get('decision') in ('accept','replay','reject')
        if r['decision']=='reject': assert r['reason'] in ('hex','syntax','headers','length','fields','auth','identity','conflict'), r
print('fuzz2 done bad=',bad)
